messages:
Aisha: quick brain-dump: propose the gateway use a short-lived per-request tail buffer for streaming responses and a circuit-aware 'soft-fallback' flow when upstreams fail mid-stream. goal: avoid hammering an open circuit and give clients a chance to resume.
Miguel: sounds useful. how does soft-fallback differ from retry shaping today?
Aisha: two things: 1) suppress immediate backend retries when the upstream cluster's circuit is open, 2) issue an opaque resume token in the trailer if we can hold a short tail so the client can reconnect and continue without side-effect duplication.
Samir: love the idea, but gotta bound it: strict TTL (default 3s), per-tenant byte caps, and single-use tokens. also prefer evict-oldest policy if we hit memory pressure.
Miguel: header sketch: 
```
# proxy -> client trailers
X-RW-Resume-Token: rtk-<hex>
X-RW-Resume-TTL: 3
X-RW-Resume-Size: 12KB
Trailer: X-RW-Resume-Token

# client -> proxy to resume
If-Resume-Token: rtk-<hex>
```
Aisha: circuit-awareness: proxy can read CB state from control plane stream and if CB==open, set X-RW-Proxy-Retry-Hint=no-retry and prefer resume flow.
Samir: implementation: lightweight per-connection ring buffer aggregated per-tenant; default tenant cap 256KB, global pool with hard cap. instrument metrics: resume.tokens.issued, resume.tokens.used, resume.buffer.evicted, retry_shaper.suppressed.
SRE: runbook bits: if resume.buffer.evictions > 1% of requests over 5m -> disable feature and investigate. watch suppressed_retry_ratio and concurrent_resume_tokens.
infra-bot: feature-flag created: resume_stream_tail (default: off). metric hooks registered.
Miguel: billing note: mark buffered segments as transient in traces so billing dedup logic can avoid charging twice on replays.
Aisha: open questions: 1) region/cluster binding for tokens (suggest bind to region and cluster) 2) allow cross-region resume? probably no. 3) should token be single-use? yes.
Samir: security: HMAC-sign tokens with region key, expire after TTL, single-use to reduce replay risk.
Aisha: next steps: I'll draft a 1-pager RFC with sequence diagram, API contract, and per-tier caps. volunteers: @Miguel for client handshake docs, @Samir for buffer impl + evict policy, @SRE for runbook. meeting scheduled Thu to review. :rocket:
